messages:

Subject: Eval handover & timing

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to run a short evaluation of Redwood for our checkout search assistant. We want to align on a short MAP and the mechanics for exchanging the prompt pack / test cases. High level ask: a 2-week sandbox with an agreed acceptance checklist and a small, ephemeral promptpack plus testcases we can run in our environment.

- Temporary access (sandbox credentials and duration)
- Licensing/usage constraints for shared prompt packs and testcases
- Any escrow / destruction commitments after the trial

From: priyom_das@redwood.com

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com

Hi Liz — great to hear. Short answer: we can do a 14-day sandbox with an MAP that binds the acceptance criteria and data handling. Draft attached. Key bullets below:

- Sandbox: dedicated ephemeral environment (RBAC + per-token lease) for 14 days; access expires automatically.
- Prompt pack / test cases: shared under a limited-use MPA (ephemeral license) — allowed for evaluation only, no external redistribution.
- Escrow & takedown: we provide a signed takedown and destruction clause in the MAP; we also offer an optional third-party escrow for sensitive corp-owned assets.

See attached: MAP-draft-v1.pdf and a sample prompt pack (stripped metadata). I've also attached an access_matrix.csv so we can map users to roles.

Next steps proposal:
1) Acme confirms acceptance criteria (short checklist) — you send back by EOD Tue 7/6.
2) We lock sandbox and provision assets Wed 7/7.
3) 14-day evaluation window: 7/7 - 7/21.

If that timeline works, I can loop Marissa (CS lead) to schedule the handoff and Kimberly (security) for SOC2/controls signoff.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (PDF, 86KB)], [Attachment: acme-sample-promptpack.zip (stub, 2.1MB)], [Attachment: access_matrix.csv (CSV, 4KB)]

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Liz — quick security/controls note so Acme can include the right asks in your procurement thread:

- SOC 2: Redwood will provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report under an NDA; we can slot that delivery before provisioning.
- Data retention: the sandbox is ephemeral; we will not persist customer-owned prompt content beyond the lease unless you opt into a retention workflow.
- Access logging: full request-level audit logs available for the duration and exportable as CSV for your audits.

Two clarifying Qs for the MAP:
1) Will Acme require us to sign a mutual NDA / MPA covering the prompt pack? If yes, procurement@acme.ai should send the preferred template.
2) For escrow: do you want an on-demand escrow (we hand to a neutral custodian on signature) or a scheduled takedown affidavit?

If helpful I can prepare a short security appendix that we attach to the MAP.

—Kimberly Park
Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
